steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Huh? What's wrong? I can't connect to the program's internal feed.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: It's... being hijacked?

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Ten years ago, I thought Bolívar would find true peace if we chased the Coalition and the Singas out of the country.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: I risked my life to fight for True Bolívarians.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: In the end, three thousand of my brothers fought to their deaths. If it wasn't for my own brother risking his life to save mine, I would've been shot that day.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: And that was the day when I finally realized.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: The Coalition, the Singas dynasty's nobles, and True Bolívarians. Not one of them truly wants to save Bolívar. All they are doing is fighting a war.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: And no matter how long this war lasts, Bolívar will never see salvation.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: To escape the turmoil, I made my way to this city.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: In a hopeless country, I found this hopeless city.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: And then we have Candela Sanchez, who's the most hopeless of us all.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: On this hopeless swath of land, she built a city far more corrupt than all Bolívarian cities combined.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: And not only is she enjoying this herself, she is even dragging all those around her into her cesspit of enjoyment.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: All of them think they lead a proper life.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: They have no idea just how much blood lies underneath them, in the city's sewers and how many scavenging beasts the place is feeding.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: She is feeding on the flesh and blood of all those who live in these lands, never to care about their lives.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: This city must die, and all of you who indulge in the pleasures this place has to offer must die with it!

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: The championship's over.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Now, I will take back this city.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: If no one else will save this country, I will.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So your father is the one behind all this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When you realized we were starting to piece it all together, you chose to divert our attention toward you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That way, even if we actually figured it out, you would get to buy time for the one pulling the strings.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's right. I'm not going to say I won, Miss Ch'en. This was never a fair fight to begin with.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You came too late, and you took on Ms. Candela's mission too hastily.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: This is the final bit of generosity I have to offer, Miss Ch'en. Surrender, along with Miss Lin.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If you give up without a fight, I can guarantee that no one will lay a finger on you.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You have nothing to do with this. There is no reason for you to jump into our morally gray mess.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I can't do that.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: This ship has been taken over by our men. If you resist, you and Miss Lin will die.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: An old friend once told me, I have to take a beating before I can learn, like a young her, that being a stubborn ass is just a stupid impulse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And even now, I've got no idea what kind of stubbornness I'm supposed to stick to and what counts as an unrealistic, stupid impulse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But my guess is she probably knows that's not enough to stop me, or my name isn't Ch'en Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do what you're gonna do. I'm in a hurry.

steps.name: Startled Male Tourist
steps.text: Hey, isn't that Mr. Pancho? What is he talking about?

steps.name: Startled Female Tourist
steps.text: I don't know. Is this some kind of special performance?

steps.name: Terrified Male Tourist
steps.text: Was that an explosion?! Where was it?!

steps.name: Terrified Female Tourist
steps.text: I think it came from the place where the first round took place! Look, there's smoke in that direction!

steps.name: Terrified Male Tourist
steps.text: Hey, hey, hey! You're kidding! Is old man Pancho serious?!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Lady Candela, there are numerous unknown forces sowing chaos in the city and the surrounding countryside.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Tsk tsk... So that's your move, Pancho?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Lady Candela, please, we need to move you somewhere safe.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Evacuate? Don't be absurd. I have the front row seat here. I'm not going anywhere.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Don't worry about the ruffians on the streets; deal with them as you see fit. My guess is that I am their ultimate objective anyway.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Oh, don't forget to clear the crowds too. Be sure to close the city's gates first, though. Send everyone home.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: After that, secure the staff.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: However.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Make sure they make preparations for the banquet, and definitely make sure the championship's live broadcast goes uninterrupted.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Protect them, but don't ruin my championship. Is that understood?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Right, and get me some new drones. They probably wrecked all the ones on the ship. We mustn't miss out on all this fun.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, you're kidding. We're here on holiday. How did this happen?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Though I guess this is what Bolívar is supposed to feel like.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Enough. Let's figure out what to do with this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy, we're tourists. This is nothing we should poke our heads into.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Would you say that to Ch'en Hui-chieh if she was standing right here?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Of course, but I'm sure you know what she'd say.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Then my answer's the same.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Alright. All I'll say is I'm not against this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Rhodes Island... Ugh, Sideroca's getting drinks. Let me go check on her.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And, besides, the two of them are on the ship too. How am I not supposed to worry?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not all that worried about them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's more, we are outsiders. It's not like we've got a side here. Though with all this ruckus going on, I very much doubt Ch'en and Lin are oblivious.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't know what's going on on the ship, and it's not very realistic for us to get on board to help them, so let's stick to the things we know we can do.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Tsk, how dare you ambush me while I have drinks in my hands.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: (I didn't expect to see something like this happen here.)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: (Looks like they are organized. The beach has fallen into chaos.)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: (I don't have a weapon on me either, so it's hard for me to do anything. Maybe I should regroup with Hoshiguma first...)

steps.name: Tourist A?
steps.text: Let's get her.

steps.name: Tourist B?
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sideroca!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Thanks, Hoshiguma!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No need to thank me. That reminds me, you're like the captain of this mission. You heard that just now, didn't you? What will Rhodes Island do about this?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm on vacation myself. Just a passerby helping with what she can won't be a problem, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha, I knew you would say that. Let's go, then.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh, right.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Red, where are you?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: No idea, Sideroca. Lots of people. Stench of blood.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Yeah, I know. Come to the beach.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I need you to protect Eyjafjalla and Sussurro.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There's a group over there. They aren't running...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Are they heading toward... the mayor?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Come, Sideroca, let's stop them!
